title: Traveling with more than $10,000 in currency
facts: There is no general federal prohibition on carrying more than $10,000 in currency or monetary instruments into or out of the United States.
A traveler transporting, mailing or shipping more than $10,000 in covered currency or monetary instruments into or out of the United States generally must file the required FinCEN/CBP report.
The reporting threshold concerns disclosure, not an automatic tax or confiscation simply because the amount exceeds $10,000.
Structuring or concealing funds to evade reporting requirements can create serious legal problems.
